structure: workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/prototype-specs is a small Playwright project that walks the Design Release 2.1 prototype (GB-notification-service at c2078fb, mounted at /design-release-2.1) and records a trace per test. playwright.config.js runs only e2e/**/*.fit.spec.js, one worker. In scope: the 12 fit specs that drove trace:prototype-dr2-1 (156 tests, all passing on 27 November 2026; index.json of traces-prototype lists the same 12 specs with the same counts): about-the-consignment (22 tests, 440 lines), description-of-the-goods (13, 362), transport-and-arrival (13, 373), documents (7, 144), consignment-parties (14, 454), address-book (9, 239), journeys (9, 417), eudpa-691 (4, 83), dashboard (9, 306), manage-notifications (7, 214), templates (12, 206) and snagging (37, 557); the shared helpers they assert through, e2e/support/journey.js (283 lines: page actions and shared assertions), fixtures.js (48), evidence.js (65) and snagging.js (63); and COVERAGE.md (249 lines: the route table, the 39 DR2.1 override views and whether each was visited, what could not be reached and why, and the numbered behaviour notes), with README.md (66) and playwright.config.js (52) for how the suite runs. Out of scope: e2e/wod-capture/ (7 *.capture.spec.js files under their own config, not matched by the fit config and absent from the trace index), explore/ (ad hoc exploration scripts and their dumps), the runner scripts (run-suite.js, collect-traces.js, gen-coverage.js, serve-prototype.js, global-setup.js), package files, playwright-report/ and test-results/. Cut one part per feature area in journey order, the end-to-end and dashboard areas after the section pages, the snag-list spec on its own, and COVERAGE.md as its own part. journey.js is read by every spec part, and each part claims only the shared assertions its own tests call.

parts.title: Section 1: about the consignment
parts.scope: e2e/about-the-consignment.fit.spec.js: the notification type question and section 1 of the live-animals and germinal journeys. Stops at the commodity details page, which is part 2.
covers: All 22 tests in about-the-consignment.fit.spec.js, across its 5 describes: notification type, origin of the import, what are you importing, main import reason, germinal products: section 1
Every route, heading, label, hint, option, error message, conditional branch and onward link each test asserts, and every shared journey.js assertion these tests call

covers: All 37 tests in snagging.fit.spec.js, across its 12 describes: origin of the import, what are you importing, main import reason, commodity details, identification details, arrival details, transit countries, transporter details, upload documents, consignment addresses, review your notification, notification submitted
Every page state each snag test reaches and every heading, label, hint, option, error message and branch it asserts, with the snag number from its title

parts.title: COVERAGE.md and suite set-up
parts.scope: COVERAGE.md in full, with README.md and playwright.config.js for how the suite runs and what it can reach. The route table rows are claimed here as reached routes; the spec behaviour behind each is the spec parts'.
covers: Every row of the Routes table: each GET route under /design-release-2.1, its view and whether it is a DR2.1 override or shared
Every row of the 39-row DR2.1 override views table, including the two unreachable overrides (permanent-address, contact-address-for-consignment)
Every item in 'Not reached, and why': each route or behaviour the suite could not reach, as a gap with its reason
Every numbered item in 'Behaviour worth knowing', noting which are marked as not asserted
The README's prototype gotchas that describe prototype behaviour (arrival date window, bespoke autocompletes, MOJ date picker)
